exposure: Implementation of strategies to reduce C-section rate based on Modified Robson Criteria audit
cohort: The study involved all C-sections performed at a tertiary care hospital, classified according to Modified Robson Criteria.
finding: The C-section rate decreased from an initial 51.54% to 39.74% after the implementation of reduction strategies following an audit.
mod_finding: The C-section rate significantly reduced from 51.54% to 39.74% after auditing with Modified Robson Criteria and implementing targeted strategies.
